annotations.title: Request testing of a new page

description: Submits a request to test a page that has no report yet. Identify its site with siteID if the site is in the listSites output (check the listPages output for that site first), or otherwise name the site with siteName; give exactly one of them. Set reviewImmediately to true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved (testing then typically takes 2 to 4 minutes); set it to false to queue the request for review by management, which typically takes 1 hour to 1 day. The pageName becomes the name of the page in later listPages output and must differ from the names of the other pages of the site; a siteName becomes the name of a new site and must not match the name of a tested site (ignoring case, white space, and punctuation). The reason is what the reviewer evaluates. A request for immediate review of a page that may already have been tested is referred to management review, and the disposition lists the possible duplicates and similar sites. A refusal, such as a duplicate request or a full queue, is reported in the disposition. Returns a confirmation with disposition details, including, on immediate approval, a report identifier and a question about whether to wait for completion with the awaitTest tool.

URL.description: 12- to 300-character URL of the page, including the https:// scheme and any query; it must not redirect to a target this deployment disallows, such as a private, loopback, or link-local address

pageName.description: 1- to 120-character name of the page, distinguishing it from every other page of the site (for the home page of a site, “home”)

reason.description: 20- to 100-character justification evaluated by the reviewer selected by reviewImmediately

reviewImmediately.description: true for immediate review with immediate approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved; false or omitted to queue the request for review by management

siteID.description: For a page of a site in the listSites output: identifier of the site, formatted s-xxxxxx (example: s-2fw2ea). Give either siteID or siteName, not both.

siteName.description: For a page of a site not in the listSites output: 1- to 80-character name of the site, usually the name of the organization or brand that presents it; it must not match the name of any site in the listSites output, ignoring case, white space, and punctuation. Give either siteID or siteName, not both.

name: requestNewTest

page identifier.description: Identifier of the page, or null if the page does not exist yet.

site identifier.description: Identifier of the site, or null if the site does not exist yet.

date and time.description: UTC date and time when the response was generated, in ISO 8601 format.

identifier.description: Unique identifier of this response (timestamp and random suffix).

this request.description: URL of the equivalent web UI page for this request.

URL.description: URL of the Kilotest MCP server.

description.description: Explanation of what Kilotest does and how to use its tools.

required: web users can obtain similar functionalities at
reason why the page should be tested

possible duplicates.description: Tested pages that may be the requested page. If one is, its latest report can be used at once.

identifier of the latest report.description: Identifier of the latest report about the page (example: 260503T0432-x9z).

name.description: Name of the page, distinguishing it from the other pages of its site.

sites.description: The sites that the page belongs to (currently always one).

anyOf.description: Identifier of the report, to pass to listIssues once the report is ready (example: 260503T0432-x9z).

similar sites.description: Existing sites that may be the requested site. If one is, a test of a page of it can be requested with requestNewTest by giving its identifier as siteID.

whether your request was referred to man.description: true if immediate review was requested but the request was referred to management review because of possible duplicates or similar sites.

required: how you can check for completion
